exploreItems.title: More than a visit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A maintained settlement is evidence of a continuing presence, different from a ship's brief arrival.

exploreItems.title: An existing place
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Cebu already had a community, trade and leadership. The Spanish settlement did not create its entire history.

exploreItems.title: Check the reach
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A settlement in one place does not establish immediate, effective control over every island.

exploreItems.title: Cebu's colonial development
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The Spanish settlement in Cebu dates to 1565. This does not erase the community that existed earlier.

exploreItems.title: Manila's colonial development
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The Spanish city in Manila dates to 1571. This is different from claiming that local settlement began in 1571.

exploreItems.title: A comparison limit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Two dated developments establish a sequence, not a complete route or universal control of the archipelago.

exploreItems.title: Economic aims
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Trade access and resources could be sought; wanting them is not proof of obtaining them.

exploreItems.title: Political and religious aims
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Influence and spreading Catholic Christianity were among imperial aims. Participants could have different priorities.

exploreItems.title: Explain without excusing
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Identifying a motive does not justify coercion or establish every resident's consent.

exploreItems.title: A place and its users
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A port needs connections and people who can move, supply and exchange goods. Geography is not the only factor.

exploreItems.title: Existing regional links
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Regional merchants helped connect Spanish newcomers to trade centered in Luzon. The networks were not created from nothing.

exploreItems.title: Avoid a guaranteed result
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A useful location can support trade without guaranteeing profit or agreement to foreign rule.

exploreItems.title: Read the departure
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Legazpi's expedition left Mexico in 1564. A departure year is not automatically an arrival year.

exploreItems.title: Read the later event
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The expedition reached the Philippine islands and established a Spanish settlement in Cebu in 1565.

exploreItems.title: Keep journeys separate
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Legazpi's expedition was distinct from Magellan's earlier voyage and from Elcano's return.

exploreItems.title: Ways of pursuing authority
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Force, agreements and institutions could be used in efforts to maintain rule.

exploreItems.title: A required payment
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Tribute is a payment required by an authority, different from assuming a voluntary gift.

exploreItems.title: Keep the context
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: One method's existence does not establish identical operation, consent or results everywhere.

exploreItems.title: A claim
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: An official's statement of authority is not the same as evidence of its effect.

exploreItems.title: Several factors
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Communications, resources and local political decisions could shape the reach of an institution.

exploreItems.title: A careful conclusion
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Ask where and when a decision was carried out. Do not infer universal control from one order.

exploreItems.title: An imperial aim
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Occupation and a continuing presence were Spanish aims. A sponsor's plan is different from local agreement.

exploreItems.title: Different roles
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Legazpi commanded; Urdaneta contributed navigation knowledge. Crews and other participants also mattered.

exploreItems.title: A result to investigate
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: An instruction or responsibility does not prove that every aim was achieved everywhere.

exploreItems.title: An Ifugao example
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: National Museum research material describes resistance to Spanish conquest. Do not apply one example to every highland community.

exploreItems.title: A later Sulu example
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: NCCA discusses Sulu diplomacy, conflict and a 1726 treaty. This is later than the 1565 expedition.

exploreItems.title: Separate contexts
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Two distinct examples challenge a claim of uniform control without proving that every community had the same experience.

exploreItems.title: A named Cebu participant
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The Cebu agreement marker names Rajah Tupas. Leadership did not begin only with Spanish offices.

exploreItems.title: An earlier Maynila
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The Intramuros Administration links the Spanish city's site with the earlier polity of Rajah Sulayman, also written Soliman.

exploreItems.title: Keep people visible
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Earlier communities had their own histories. A later colonial institution did not create all local life or everyone's opinions.

exploreItems.title: An agreement in context
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The Cebu agreement involved named leaders. It does not establish every person's wishes or remove the earlier conflict.

exploreItems.title: Evidence of resistance
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The NHCP Bangkusay marker records resistance in 1571 and identifies a leader from Macabebe. It does not identify that leader as Rajah Sulayman.

exploreItems.title: A response has a scope
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: An agreement or an act of resistance in one setting cannot be treated as the identical choice of every community.

exploreItems.title: A consequence
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Effects concern what followed from an action, not only what its sponsor wanted.

exploreItems.title: People and evidence
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Investigate who was affected, in what place and time, rather than invent a universal burden.

exploreItems.title: Local responses
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Negotiation, adaptation and resistance could vary. One response does not reveal every person's private motive.

fields.description: Complete 10 activities: six clue-and-conclusion decisions and four matching tasks. Both parts of an evidence decision count together as one activity. Get at least 7 correct to pass. All lesson clues are available even without saving them in your journal.

fields.optionB: Cebu had no people or trade before 1565
fields.optionC: A new settlement erased every earlier event
fields.optionD: All islands instantly came under effective control
